add_rc_deps(resource.rc ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/res/regedt32.ico)

# regedt32.exe is all Rust (regedt32-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/regedt32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# regedt32.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/regedt32-rust/src/regedt32/regedt32.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(regedt32_res OBJECT resource.rc)
target_compile_definitions(regedt32_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(regedt32_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(REGEDT32_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/CMakeFiles/oldnames.dir/oldnames.a)
add_cargo_module(regedt32 regedt32-cargo regedt32.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE regedt32-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS regedt32_res ${REGEDT32_REUSED})
